# Bart Ehrman Courses Online

> > Scholarly resources on early Christianity, New Testament textual criticism, and historical Jesus research by renowned biblical scholar Bart D. Ehrman

This site features Bart Ehrman's academic work exploring biblical authorship, manuscript transmission, early Christian history, and the historical Jesus through rigorous scholarship. It includes educational courses, a podcast series, and in-depth articles examining biblical texts and figures from critical historical perspectives.

## Key Topics

- Bart D. Ehrman
- New Testament textual criticism
- Historical Jesus
- Early Christianity
- Biblical authorship
- Gospel scholarship
- Manuscript transmission and corruption
- Second Temple Judaism
- Biblical canonization
- Pauline epistles
- Eschatology
- Hermeneutics and biblical interpretation
- Roman Empire context
- Apostolic Fathers

## Core Resources

- [Misquoting Jesus with Bart Ehrman Podcast](https://www.bartehrman.com/podcast): Main podcast page for Misquoting Jesus with Bart Ehrman series
- [The Text of the New Testament: Its Transmission, Corruption, and Restoration](https://www.bartehrman.com/the-text-of-the-new-testament-its-transmission-corruption-and-restoration): Ehrman & Metzger's textual criticism reference on NT manuscripts

## Biblical Canon and Interpretation

- [Canonization of the Bible: Understanding How We Got the Bible](https://www.bartehrman.com/canonization-of-the-bible): Traces biblical canon formation and scripture selection process
- [Hermeneutics Meaning: What is Biblical Hermeneutics In Simple Terms?](https://www.bartehrman.com/hermeneutics): Explains biblical interpretation methods and hermeneutic principles
- [Eschatology: Exploring Its Meaning & Conflicting Views (Chart)](https://www.bartehrman.com/eschatology): Compares Christian eschatological views from early to modern theology

## Historical Jesus and Early Christianity

- [Teachings of Jesus: 10 Messages Jesus Really Taught](https://www.bartehrman.com/teachings-of-jesus): Explores 10 authentic teachings of historical Jesus from synoptic Gospels
- [Second Temple Judaism: Meaning and Timeline](https://www.bartehrman.com/second-temple-judaism): Explores Second Temple period's impact on Christianity and Judaism
- [Pontius Pilate: Biography & Role in Jesus' Crucifixion](https://www.bartehrman.com/pontius-pilate): Historical analysis of Pontius Pilate beyond Gospel portrayals
- [How Did John the Baptist Die?](https://www.bartehrman.com/how-did-john-the-baptist-die): Analyzes John the Baptist's death under Herod Antipas via Gospels/Josephus

## New Testament Authorship Studies

- [Who Wrote the Book of Acts? (And When Was Acts Written?)](https://www.bartehrman.com/who-wrote-the-book-of-acts): Explores authorship mystery of Book of Acts with historical analysis
- [Who Wrote the Book of Luke: Unravelling the Mystery](https://www.bartehrman.com/who-wrote-the-book-of-luke): Analyzes Gospel of Luke authorship using scholarly findings
- [Who Wrote 1 Thessalonians? (Authentic or Forgery?)](https://www.bartehrman.com/who-wrote-1-thessalonians): Examines Pauline authorship and authenticity of 1 Thessalonians

## Church Fathers and Early Christian Figures

- [Polycarp: Life and Significance in Early Christianity](https://www.bartehrman.com/polycarp): Examines Polycarp's role as Bishop of Smyrna and Apostolic Father
- [Jerome: Everything About the "Doctor of the Church"](https://www.bartehrman.com/jerome): Biography of St. Jerome, ascetic scholar and Latin Vulgate translator

## Biblical History and Comparative Religion

- [Edomites: Biblical Legend or Real People? (PLUS Modern Day Edom)](https://www.bartehrman.com/edomites): Investigates Edomites as Esau's descendants in biblical history
- [Do Muslims Believe in Jesus? (Or His Death & Resurrection)](https://www.bartehrman.com/do-muslims-believe-in-jesus-christ): Compares Islamic and Christian beliefs about Jesus Christ
- [Non-Denominational Church: Meaning and Beliefs](https://www.bartehrman.com/non-denominational-church): Examines rise and characteristics of non-denominational Christianity

## Optional

- [Dan McClellan's AMA](https://www.bartehrman.com/ama-dan-mcclellan): Ask Me Anything session with biblical scholar Dan McClellan
- [Your Historical Jesus Quiz Results](https://www.bartehrman.com/fs-jesus-quiz-2): Quiz results page offering free historical Jesus lessons
- [Your Free Guide is On Its Way!](https://www.bartehrman.com/your-free-guide-is-on-its-way): Download confirmation page for free Biblical Studies guide
